ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure gives two Lewis structures, left and right. In the structure on the left, the left carbon is connected to two H and forms a double bond with the carbon labeled Cx; Cx is also connected to one H, and forms a single bond with the oxygen on the right; three pairs of lone electrons are drawn around the oxygen. In the structure on the right, the left carbon is connected to three H and forms a single bond with the carbon labeled Cx; Cx forms a double bond with oxygen, and one pair of lone electrons is drawn beside Cx; there are two pairs of lone electrons around the oxygen. Reasoning: Use the formal charge formula FC = number of valence electrons − number of nonbonding electrons − half the number of bonding electrons. In the structure on the left, the single-bonded oxygen has three pairs of lone electrons, FC(O)=6−6−1=−1; the two carbons satisfy the usual valence states, and the formal charges are 0. In the structure on the right, oxygen is double-bonded oxygen and has two pairs of lone electrons, so the formal charge is 0; the carbon labeled Cx has one pair of lone electrons, one C—C single bond, and one C=O double bond, FC(C)=4−2−3=−1. Therefore, the left side places the negative charge on oxygen, and the right side places the negative charge on carbon. A negative charge is more stable on the more electronegative oxygen, so the structure on the left is more reasonable.

method.method_draft: From the image, compute formal charges for the key atoms in each candidate. In the left structure, the singly bonded oxygen with three lone pairs has FC = 6 − 6 − 1 = −1, while the carbons are neutral. In the right structure, the central carbon with a lone pair, a single bond to CH3, and a double bond to O has FC = 4 − 2 − 3 = −1, while oxygen is neutral. Since a negative charge is more stable on oxygen than on carbon, choose Left.

推理：用形式电荷公式FC = 价电子数 − 非键电子数 − 成键电子数的一半。左侧结构中，单键氧有三对孤电子，FC(O)=6−6−1=−1；两个碳满足通常价态，形式电荷为0。右侧结构中，氧为双键氧且有两对孤电子，形式电荷为0；标记为Cx的碳有一对孤电子、一个C—C单键和一个C=O双键，FC(C)=4−2−3=−1。因此左侧把负电荷放在氧上，右侧把负电荷放在碳上。负电荷在电负性更大的氧上更稳定，所以左侧结构更合理。
